It is built with\nPython 3.14.6 and the standard library only (`http.server`, `sqlite3`, `json`,\netc.).\n\n## How to start and verify the server\n\n```bash\n# Run in the foreground on the port specified by PORT (default 8080).\n./run.sh\n\n# In another terminal, verify the health endpoint:\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\": true}\n```\n\n`run.sh` executes `uv run --python 3.14.6 python server.py`. The server listens\non `127.0.0.1` and binds to the `PORT` environment variable.\n\n## Entry point and major modules\n\n| File | Responsibility |\n|------|------------------|\n| `server.py` | Entry point. Imports `Handler` from `api` and starts `http.server.HTTPServer`. |\n| `api.py` | HTTP request/response helpers, route tables, the `Handler` class, and endpoint handlers. |\n| `storage.py` | SQLite persistence layer. Defines the `Storage` class and the module-level `storage` singleton. |\n| `domain.py` | Pure, deterministic game-rule and authentication computations. |\n| `constants.py` | Literal game tables, valid choice sets, and compiled route patterns. |\n| `run.sh` | Launcher script required by the evaluation harness. |\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state is stored in a single SQLite file named `game.db` in the\ncurrent working directory. The `storage` singleton in `storage.py` initializes\nthe schema on import, so the database is created as soon as the server starts.\n\nTables (declared in `Storage._TABLES` in dependency order):\n\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashes and salts.\n- `sessions` — combat initiative order, round/turn index, and active conditions.\n- `compendium_monsters` and `compendium_items` — reusable reference entries.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — classic campaign state and log.\n- `campaign_quests`, `campaign_factions`, `campaign_npcs` — quest and relationship tracking.\n- `campaign_inventory`, `crafting_projects` — shared inventory and downtime crafting.\n- `campaign_sessions`, `session_attendance` — session scheduling and attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members` — live-play campaign lobby, party, and character build state.\n- `narrations` — chronological narration, action, travel, rest, scene, and resolution events.\n- `campaign_documents` — durable story text and DM-only notes.\n- `scenes` — named scenes within a play campaign, each `open` or `closed`.\n- `campaign_locations`, `location_connections` — location graph for travel turns.\n- `encounters` — active/closed combat encounters with combatants, conditions, and rewards.\n\n`POST /v1/storage/reset` drops and recreates all tables except `users`, keeping\nregistered actors available across the maintenance reset performed by the\ncumulative evaluator suite. `GET /v1/storage/status` reports the driver, schema\nversion, and initialization flag.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`api.py` keeps four ordered lists of route tuples `(compiled_pattern, handler)`:\n`GET_ROUTES`, `POST_ROUTES`, `PUT_ROUTES`, and `DELETE_ROUTES`. The first match\nwins, preserving the dispatch order of the original implementation, which\nmatters where a more specific regex could otherwise shadow a shorter exact path.\n\n`Handler` delegates each HTTP method to `_dispatch`, which iterates the\nappropriate route table, passes the `re.Match` object (and parsed JSON body for\nmutating methods) to the matched handler, and falls back to\n`{\"error\": \"not found\"}` with HTTP 404.\n\nDynamic segments (e.g., `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`) are captured by the\nregex and passed to the handler as a `re.Match` object.\n\n### Response contract\n\nAll JSON responses are sent via `send_json`, which sets `Content-Type` and\n`Content-Length`. Error payloads are intentionally coarse-grained (e.g.\n`{\"error\": \"invalid request\"}`) and match the original behavior.\n\n### Authentication and access control\n\n- `_authenticate` validates the `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`\n  header and returns the actor along with an error code (401 for missing/\n  malformed tokens, 403 for unknown users or role mismatches).\n- `_require_auth` sends the appropriate JSON response and returns `None` on\n  failure.\n- `_load_play_campaign` fetches a live campaign and enforces access: with\n  `require_owner=True` the actor must own the campaign; otherwise the actor must\n  be either the owner or a party member.\n- `_load_encounter` fetches an encounter within a campaign and sends the standard\n  404 response when it is missing.\n- `_require_encounter_owner` combines owner-only campaign access with encounter\n  existence for DM-only encounter mutations.\n\nThe legacy `authenticate`, `authenticate_player`, and `authenticate_actor`\nfunctions remain as thin wrappers for compatibility.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Core helpers (`/v1/dice/*`, `/v1/checks/*`, `/v1/encounters/*`, `/v1/initiative/*`)\n\n- Dice expression parsing (`2d6+3`, `1d20-1`) and min/max/average stats.\n- Ability checks with margin calculation.\n- Encounter adjusted XP and difficulty using the DMG multiplier table.\n- Deterministic initiative ordering: score descending, then dexterity descending,\n  then name ascending.\n\n### Character helpers (`/v1/characters/*`)\n\n- Ability score modifier (floors negative halves).\n- Proficiency bonus by level.\n- Derived stats: modifiers, AC (base + capped DEX + shield), and max HP.\n  The derived-stats endpoint uses a simplified HP formula; class-based progression\n  lives in `domain.max_hp_for_level` and is used by the play-campaign build path.\n\n### Combat (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`)\n\n- Create a session from a list of combatants; the system sorts them and stores\n  the order.\n- Add conditions to a combatant with a remaining-rounds duration.\n- Advance the turn; when the turn wraps, the round increments and the active\n  combatant's conditions have their remaining duration decremented.\n\n### Auth (`/v1/auth/*`)\n\n- Register with username validation, password length, and role (`dm` / `player`).\n- Login with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 verification and a deterministic session token.\n\n### Compendium (`/v1/compendium/*`)\n\n- Create and read monsters and items by slug.\n\n### Classic campaigns (`/v1/campaigns/*`)\n\n- Create a campaign, add characters, append events, and read the aggregate\n  campaign state (`characters` + `log_count`).\n- Manage quests, factions, NPCs, inventory, equipment, crafting, and sessions.\n- Audit, export, and analytics endpoints report aggregate counts.\n\n### PHB rules (`/v1/phb/*`)\n\n- Wizard level 5 spell slots.\n- Long rest restoration (HP, hit dice, exhaustion).\n- Carrying capacity and encumbrance.\n\n### DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`)\n\n- Encounter builder that looks up monsters and returns adjusted XP + difficulty\n  recommendation.\n- Hardcoded tier-1 loot parcel and deterministic session recap helpers.\n\n### Play campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`)\n\n- DM-owned live campaigns with a `lobby` -> `active` lifecycle.\n- Players join with a character; the DM starts the campaign once at least two\n  players have joined.\n- Deterministic player/DM round-robin turn queue.\n- DM narrations, player actions, travel/rest turns, and DM resolutions advance\n  the event log and turn queue.\n- Turn nudges track how many times the DM has prompted the current actor.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` returns the public story for players and\n  both story and `dm_notes` for the DM. `PUT /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document`\n  updates it (DM only).\n\n### Scenes, locations, and encounters (`/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/...`)\n\n- Scenes: DM creates, enters, and closes named scenes. `GET .../scenes/current`\n  returns the current open scene for all authorized actors.\n- Locations: DM creates locations and directed connections with travel-turn\n  costs. Authorized actors can list reachable destinations from a location.\n- Encounters: DM creates encounters, adds/removes monster combatants, and\n  binds/unbinds party members. Party members act on their initiative turn.\n- Damage/healing applies to encounter combatants and updates monster state or\n  the bound party member's persistent HP.\n- Conditions apply to a combatant by `monster_id` or member username and expire\n  at the start of that combatant's next active turn.\n- Delay and ready actions allow a player to reposition in initiative or declare\n  a triggered action.\n- Rewards (XP and loot) are recorded once per encounter; closing and ending an\n  encounter transitions back to exploration.\n\n### Play-campaign characters (`/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{cid}/...`)\n\n- Ownership can be claimed by a party member and transferred to another party\n  member.\n- The owner builds the character with race, class, background, and ability scores,\n  producing level-1 HP, hit dice, and proficiency bonus.\n- Level-up advances by exactly one level at a time using `domain.max_hp_for_level`.\n- Skill checks combine an ability score, proficiency bonus, and a declared\n  proficiency.\n- Damage, death saves, and status endpoints track durable HP and death-save\n  state.\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. Define the route pattern in `constants.py` if it has dynamic segments, or use\n   a literal `re.compile(r\"^/v1/...$\")` in `api.py`.\n2. Add a handler function in `api.py` near the relevant domain group. Handlers\n   receive `(handler, match)` for GET and `(handler, match, body)` for POST/PUT/\n   DELETE.\n3. Append the tuple to the correct ordered route table. If the route could\n   shadow or be shadowed by an existing regex, place it in the same relative\n   position as the original implementation.\n4. Reuse `_load_play_campaign`, `_load_encounter`, and `_require_encounter_owner`\n   for access control when the existing semantics match; otherwise keep the\n   explicit checks to preserve exact status-code ordering.\n\n### Pure logic\n\nGame-rule calculations belong in `domain.py`. They should not import `storage`\nor perform I/O. Use the constants from `constants.py` rather than hardcoding\nnumbers inline.\n\n### Persistence\n\n- Add a new table by extending `Storage._TABLES` in order (order matters for\n  `CREATE` and `DROP` during reset), then add accessor methods. Use the\n  `_connection()` context manager to ensure every connection is closed. Keep the\n  same return conventions (`True` / `False` for insert conflicts, `None` for\n  missing rows, dict/list for reads).\n- Update `Storage.reset` only if the new table must be dropped during a reset.\n\n### Testing\n\nThe service is designed to be tested by starting it on an ephemeral port and\nhitting the HTTP endpoints. The database is local, so reset it between test cases\nwith `POST /v1/storage/reset` to keep tests deterministic. The default\n`log_message` implementation is suppressed so request logs do not clutter stdout.\n\n### Do not change\n\nThis is a refactoring checkpoint. Preserve the exact endpoint set, status\ncodes, response bodies, validation rules, and persistence semantics. AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if existing is not None:\n                return False\n            active = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND status = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, \"active\"),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if active is not None:\n                return False\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO encounters (campaign_id, id, name, status, round, turn_index, combatants_json, conditions_json, order_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id, name, \"active\", 1, 0, json.dumps([]), json.dumps({}), None),\n            )\n            campaign = self.get_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n            pre_combat_actor = campaign[\"current_actor\"] if campaign else \"\"\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET phase = 'combat', pre_combat_actor = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (pre_combat_actor, campaign_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return True\n\n    def get_encounter(self, campaign_id, encounter_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, status, combatants_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            if any(c.get(\"monster_id\") == monster[\"monster_id\"] for c in combatants):\n                return False\n            combatants.append(monster)\n            order_json = row[1]\n            if order_json:\n                order = json.loads(order_json)\n                order.append(monster)\n                order_json = json.dumps(order)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET combatants_json = ?, order_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(combatants), order_json, campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return True\n\n    def remove_encounter_monster(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, monster_id):\n        \"\"\"Remove a monster combatant from an encounter by monster_id.\n\n        Returns True when a combatant was removed, False when the monster_id was\n        not present, or None when the encounter is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            new_combatants = [c for c in combatants if c.get(\"monster_id\") != monster_id]\n            if len(new_combatants) == len(combatants):\n                return False\n            order_json = row[1]\n            if order_json:\n                order = [c for c in json.loads(order_json) if c.get(\"monster_id\") != monster_id]\n                order_json = json.dumps(order)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET combatants_json = ?, order_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(new_combatants), order_json, campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return True\n\n    def add_encounter_member(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, username, party_member, initiative):\n        \"\"\"Bind a party member as a combatant in an encounter.\n\n        Returns True on success, False when the member is already bound, or\n        None when the encounter is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            if any(c.get(\"member\") == username for c in combatants):\n                return False\n            combatant = {\n                \"member\": username,\n                \"character_id\": party_member[\"character_id\"],\n                \"name\": party_member[\"name\"],\n                \"initiative\": initiative,\n            }\n            combatants.append(combatant)\n            order_json = row[1]\n            if order_json:\n                order = json.loads(order_json)\n                order.append(combatant)\n                order_json = json.dumps(order)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET combatants_json = ?, order_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(combatants), order_json, campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return True\n\n    def remove_encounter_member(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, username):\n        \"\"\"Unbind a party member from an encounter by username.\n\n        Returns True when a combatant was removed, False when the member was\n        not bound, or None when the encounter is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            new_combatants = [c for c in combatants if c.get(\"member\") != username]\n            if len(new_combatants) == len(combatants):\n                return False\n            order_json = row[1]\n            if order_json:\n                order = [c for c in json.loads(order_json) if c.get(\"member\") != username]\n                order_json = json.dumps(order)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET combatants_json = ?, order_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(new_combatants), order_json, campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return True\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _encounter_order(combatants):\n        \"\"\"Return combatants sorted by initiative descending, then name, then kind.\"\"\"\n\n        def key(c):\n            return (-int(c[\"initiative\"]), c[\"name\"], 0 if \"member\" in c else 1)\n\n        return sorted(combatants, key=key)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _active_combatant(ordered, round_, turn_index):\n        \"\"\"Build the active-combatant payload for a round and turn index.\"\"\"\n        if not ordered:\n            return None\n        idx = turn_index % len(ordered)\n        c = ordered[idx]\n        kind = \"player\" if \"member\" in c else \"monster\"\n        return {\n            \"round\": round_,\n            \"turn_index\": turn_index,\n            \"active\": {\"name\": c[\"name\"], \"kind\": kind, \"initiative\": c[\"initiative\"]},\n        }\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _ordered_combatants(combatants, order_json):\n        \"\"\"Return the authoritative ordered combatants list for an encounter.\n\n        If ``order_json`` is set, use it; otherwise fall back to initiative\n        order computed from ``combatants``.\n        \"\"\"\n        if order_json:\n            return json.loads(order_json)\n        return Storage._encounter_order(combatants)\n\n    def get_encounter_turn(self, campaign_id, encounter_id):\n        \"\"\"Return the current round, turn index, and active combatant.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT round, turn_index, combatants_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        ordered = self._ordered_combatants(json.loads(row[2]), row[3])\n        return self._active_combatant(ordered, row[0], row[1])\n\n    def get_encounter_active_member(self, campaign_id, encounter_id):\n        \"\"\"Return the username of the active member combatant, or None.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT round, turn_index, combatants_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        ordered = self._ordered_combatants(json.loads(row[2]), row[3])\n        if not ordered:\n            return None\n        idx = row[1] % len(ordered)\n        return ordered[idx].get(\"member\")\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _condition_key(combatant):\n        \"\"\"Return the identifier used to key conditions for a combatant.\"\"\"\n        return combatant.get(\"monster_id\") or combatant.get(\"member\")\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _expire_conditions(conditions, key):\n        \"\"\"Decrement remaining rounds for ``key`` and remove any that reach 0.\"\"\"\n        active = conditions.get(key, [])\n        updated = []\n        for cond in active:\n            cond[\"remaining_rounds\"] -= 1\n            if cond[\"remaining_rounds\"] > 0:\n                updated.append(cond)\n        if updated:\n            conditions[key] = updated\n        else:\n            conditions.pop(key, None)\n        return conditions\n\n    def add_encounter_condition(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, target, condition, duration):\n        \"\"\"Apply a named condition to an encounter combatant.\n\n        ``target`` matches a monster's ``monster_id`` or a member's username.\n        Returns the target's updated conditions list, None when the encounter\n        is missing, or False when the target is not found.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json, conditions_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            conditions = json.loads(row[1])\n            found = False\n            for c in combatants:\n                if self._condition_key(c) == target:\n                    found = True\n                    break\n            if not found:\n                return False\n            conditions.setdefault(target, []).append(\n                {\"condition\": condition, \"remaining_rounds\": duration}\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET conditions_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(conditions), campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return list(conditions[target])\n\n    def get_encounter_status(self, campaign_id, encounter_id):\n        \"\"\"Return the full encounter state, including conditions for every combatant.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, status, round, turn_index, combatants_json, conditions_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        name, status, round_, turn_index, combatants, conditions = (\n            row[0],\n            row[1],\n            row[2],\n            row[3],\n            json.loads(row[4]),\n            json.loads(row[5]),\n        )\n        ordered = self._ordered_combatants(combatants, row[6])\n        active = self._active_combatant(ordered, round_, turn_index)\n        order = []\n        for c in ordered:\n            kind = \"player\" if \"member\" in c else \"monster\"\n            order.append(\n                {\"name\": c[\"name\"], \"kind\": kind, \"initiative\": c[\"initiative\"]}\n            )\n        conditions_map = {\n            self._condition_key(c): list(conditions.get(self._condition_key(c), []))\n            for c in ordered\n            if self._condition_key(c) is not None\n        }\n        return {\n            \"id\": encounter_id,\n            \"campaign_id\": campaign_id,\n            \"name\": name,\n            \"status\": status,\n            \"round\": round_,\n            \"turn_index\": turn_index,\n            \"active\": active[\"active\"] if active else None,\n            \"order\": order,\n            \"conditions\": conditions_map,\n        }\n\n    def advance_encounter_turn(self, campaign_id, encounter_id):\n        \"\"\"Advance to the next combatant in initiative order.\n\n        Decrements conditions on the newly active combatant at the start of its\n        turn and removes any that reach 0 remaining rounds. Returns the new\n        turn payload, or None when the encounter is missing or has no\n        combatants.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT round, turn_index, combatants_json, order_json, conditions_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            round_, turn_index, combatants = row[0], row[1], json.loads(row[2])\n            conditions = json.loads(row[4])\n            ordered = self._ordered_combatants(combatants, row[3])\n            if not ordered:\n                return None\n            turn_index += 1\n            if turn_index >= len(ordered):\n                turn_index = 0\n                round_ += 1\n            active = ordered[turn_index]\n            key = self._condition_key(active)\n            if key is not None:\n                conditions = self._expire_conditions(conditions, key)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET round = ?, turn_index = ?, conditions_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (round_, turn_index, json.dumps(conditions), campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return self._active_combatant(ordered, round_, turn_index)\n\n    def delay_encounter_turn(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, new_index):\n        \"\"\"Move the current combatant to a later position in the order.\n\n        If ``new_index`` is None, the combatant is moved to the last position.\n        Returns the updated order list, None when the encounter is missing, or\n        False when ``new_index`` is not a legal later position.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT turn_index, combatants_json, order_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            turn_index, combatants, order_json = row[0], json.loads(row[1]), row[2]\n            ordered = self._ordered_combatants(combatants, order_json)\n            if not ordered:\n                return False\n            if new_index is None:\n                new_index = len(ordered) - 1\n            if new_index <= turn_index or new_index >= len(ordered):\n                return False\n            current = ordered.pop(turn_index)\n            ordered.insert(new_index, current)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET order_json = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(ordered), new_index, campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return ordered\n\n    def damage_encounter_combatant(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, target, amount):\n        \"\"\"Apply deterministic damage to an encounter combatant.\n\n        Returns a dict with target, hp_before, hp_after, and damage, or None\n        when the encounter is missing, or False when the target is not found.\n        Monster combatants are matched by ``monster_id``; party members are\n        matched by ``member`` username and their HP is stored in the members\n        table.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            for c in combatants:\n                if c.get(\"monster_id\") == target:\n                    hp_before = int(c.get(\"hp_current\", c.get(\"hp_max\", 0)))\n                    hp_after = max(0, hp_before - amount)\n                    c[\"hp_current\"] = hp_after\n                    conn.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE encounters SET combatants_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                        (json.dumps(combatants), campaign_id, encounter_id),\n                    )\n                    conn.commit()\n                    return {\n                        \"target\": target,\n                        \"hp_before\": hp_before,\n                        \"hp_after\": hp_after,\n                        \"damage\": amount,\n                    }\n                if c.get(\"member\") == target:\n                    member_row = conn.execute(\n                        \"SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n                        (campaign_id, target),\n                    ).fetchone()\n                    if member_row is None:\n                        return False\n                    hp_before = member_row[0]\n                    hp_after = max(0, hp_before - amount)\n                    status = \"unconscious\" if hp_after == 0 else \"conscious\"\n                    if hp_after > 0:\n                        conn.execute(\n                            \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = 0, death_save_failures = 0 WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n                            (hp_after, status, campaign_id, target),\n                        )\n                    else:\n                        conn.execute(\n                            \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n                            (hp_after, status, campaign_id, target),\n                        )\n                    conn.commit()\n                    return {\n                        \"target\": target,\n                        \"hp_before\": hp_before,\n                        \"hp_after\": hp_after,\n                        \"damage\": amount,\n                    }\n            return False\n\n    def heal_encounter_combatant(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, target, amount):\n        \"\"\"Apply deterministic healing to an encounter combatant.\n\n        Returns a dict with target, hp_before, hp_after, and healing, or None\n        when the encounter is missing, or False when the target is not found.\n        HP caps at the combatant's hp_max.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            for c in combatants:\n                if c.get(\"monster_id\") == target:\n                    hp_max = int(c.get(\"hp_max\", 0))\n                    hp_before = int(c.get(\"hp_current\", hp_max))\n                    hp_after = min(hp_max, hp_before + amount)\n                    c[\"hp_current\"] = hp_after\n                    conn.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE encounters SET combatants_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                        (json.dumps(combatants), campaign_id, encounter_id),\n                    )\n                    conn.commit()\n                    return {\n                        \"target\": target,\n                        \"hp_before\": hp_before,\n                        \"hp_after\": hp_after,\n                        \"healing\": amount,\n                    }\n                if c.get(\"member\") == target:\n                    member_row = conn.execute(\n                        \"SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n                        (campaign_id, target),\n                    ).fetchone()\n                    if member_row is None:\n                        return False\n                    hp_before, hp_max = member_row\n                    hp_after = min(hp_max, hp_before + amount)\n                    status = \"unconscious\" if hp_after == 0 else \"conscious\"\n                    if hp_after > 0:\n                        conn.execute(\n                            \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = 0, death_save_failures = 0 WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n                            (hp_after, status, campaign_id, target),\n                        )\n                    else:\n                        conn.execute(\n                            \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n                            (hp_after, status, campaign_id, target),\n                        )\n                    conn.commit()\n                    return {\n                        \"target\": target,\n                        \"hp_before\": hp_before,\n                        \"hp_after\": hp_after,\n                        \"healing\": amount,\n                    }\n            return False\n\n    def award_encounter_rewards(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, xp, loot):\n        \"\"\"Record deterministic XP and loot for an encounter.\n\n        Returns the reward record on success, False when rewards have already\n        been awarded, or None when the encounter is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT status, xp_awarded, rewards_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            if row[1] > 0 or row[2] != '[]':\n                return False\n            rewards = [{\"slug\": item[\"slug\"], \"quantity\": item[\"quantity\"]} for item in loot]\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET xp_awarded = ?, rewards_json = ?
